home.welcome.body: We're thrilled to invite you to celebrate our wedding with us. Your presence would mean the world to us as we begin this new chapter together.

story.heading: Our Story
story.subtitle: The important checkpoints of our relationship
story.timeline.0.title: First Met
story.timeline.0.description: We met on an exploration trip, with our friends Xavier and Katulin. We went to Geres for the day and we couldn't stop laughing together.
story.timeline.1.title: First Date
story.timeline.1.description: Our first official date was in Porto for a pleasent weekend together. After that we kept videochatting non-stop.
story.timeline.2.title: Moved In Together
story.timeline.2.description: When João moved to Brno, Zuza ended up spending most of her days with him. At the end of 2021, João asked her to officially moved in.
story.timeline.3.title: Taco
story.timeline.3.description: After getting out of a no-dogs apartment and Zuza having graduated, we decided to get ourselves a dog. Taco became our first baby.
story.timeline.4.title: The House
story.timeline.4.description: After a long search and a half a year pause on searching for houses, while on our way to a random weekend stroll, we passed through a "house for sale" sign. Turns out this one was meant to be.
story.timeline.5.title: The Proposal
story.timeline.5.description: After an exciting Kygo concert, when they got back to the hotel João had surprised Zuza with, Zuza laid in bed and asked for a glass of water. João brought her the glass but no water was found inside, instead, there was a ring.
story.timeline.6.title: The little (big) one
story.timeline.6.description: After an exciting Kygo concert, when they got back to the hotel João had surprised Zuza with, Zuza laid in bed and asked for a glass of water. João brought her the glass but no water was found inside, instead, there was a ring.
story.timeline.7.title: Our Wedding Day
story.timeline.7.description: And now we're here! We're so excited to celebrate this special day with all of you. Thank you for being part of our journey.
story.closing.heading: And the adventure continues...
story.closing.body: We can't wait to write the next chapter with all of you by our side.

details.venue.parking.heading: Parking Information
details.venue.parking.body: There are parking spots throughout the village. Several can be found on the main street, others behind the church or at the village end. Lesná is a rather small village so you'll be walking 5 minutes at most.
details.schedule.heading: Schedule
details.schedule.ceremony.title: Ceremony
details.schedule.ceremony.body: The wedding ceremony begins. Please arrive 15 minutes early to find your seat.
details.schedule.cocktail.title: Cocktail Hour
details.schedule.cocktail.body: Enjoy drinks and appetizers while the wedding party takes photos.
details.schedule.reception.title: Reception
details.schedule.reception.body: Dinner, dancing, and celebration! Join us for an unforgettable evening.
details.schedule.lastdance.title: Last Dance
details.dresscode.heading: Dress Code
details.dresscode.intro: We want you to feel comfortable! Note that we will be in the garden so choose your footwear wisely. Here are some suggestions:
details.dresscode.item1: For guests: Cocktail dresses, nice slacks with dress shirts, suits
details.dresscode.item2: Please avoid: Jeans, high heel shoes
details.dresscode.item3: Colors to avoid: White, ivory, or anything that might look bridal
details.dresscode.colors.label: Wedding Colors:
details.dresscode.colors.note: (Feel free to incorporate these colors, but it's not required!)
details.accommodation.heading: Accommodation
details.accommodation.intro: There are a lot of accommodation options. Feel free to reach out to discuss them. We will have tents in our backyard for those who prefer camping and we'll have the first floor of our house stuffed with sleeping bags for those who prefer sleeping inside. The village has a few accommodations up for renting that you can find below and there are plenty of places you can stay at in Znojmo. We will be having the ceremony in Znojmo city hall and then will have a bus to bring us to the venue. We will also have a 'chauffeur' driving guests to their homes/hotels throughout the night so don't worry about how you are getting home. Assuming you can still walk.
details.accommodation.help: Need help with accommodation or want to stay with us (house or backyard)? Please let us know in your RSVP, and we'll be happy to assist you with booking or recommendations!
details.faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
details.faq.plusone.a: Due to venue capacity, we can only accommodate guests formally invited. If you received a plus-one, it will be indicated on your invitation.
details.faq.children.a: Children are welcome! Just let us know if you're planning to bring your little one in the extra notes in the RSVP so that we can prepare accordingly.
details.faq.dietary.q: What if I have dietary restrictions?
details.faq.dietary.a: Please let us know about any dietary restrictions or allergies in your RSVP, and we'll make sure to accommodate you!
details.faq.transport.a: Yes, there will be a bus taking guests from the city hall where the ceremony will take place to the venue. In the evening/night, there will be a driver taking guests to their homes/hotels.
details.faq.weather.a: July in South Moravia is usually sunny and quite warm (25/30 degrees maximum) with the nights around the 15 degrees mark.
details.faq.gifts.a: Your presence is the greatest gift! However, if you'd like to give a gift, we have a registry at [Store Name] or you can contribute to our honeymoon fund.
details.contact.heading: Have More Questions?
details.contact.body: Feel free to reach out to us directly!
photos.heading: Wedding Photos
photos.subtitle: Share your favorite moments from our special day
photos.upload.heading: Upload Your Photos
photos.upload.intro: We'd love to see the wedding through your eyes! Please upload any photos or videos you took during the celebration to our shared Google Drive folder.
photos.upload.step1.heading: Click the button below
photos.upload.step1.body: This will open our shared Google Drive folder
photos.upload.step2.heading: Upload your photos
photos.upload.step2.body: Click "New" → "File upload" or simply drag and drop your photos
photos.upload.step3.heading: That's it!
photos.upload.step3.body: We'll be able to see all the wonderful photos you share
photos.upload.body: Share your photos from our special day and we'll add them to our wedding album.
photos.upload.success: Photos uploaded successfully! Thank you for sharing.
photos.empty.heading: No Photos Yet
photos.empty.body: Be the first to share a photo from our special day!
photos.login.heading: Login Required
photos.login.body: Please log in with your invitation credentials to view and upload wedding photos.
photos.upload.note: You may need to sign in to your Google account to upload photos. Don't worry - we can't see your personal information, only the photos you upload to our folder!
photos.alt.heading: Alternative: Google Photos
photos.alt.body: Prefer Google Photos? We also have a shared album there!
photos.guidelines.heading: Photo Guidelines
photos.guidelines.1: Upload as many photos as you'd like - we want to see them all!
photos.guidelines.2: Videos are welcome too! Share those candid moments and speeches.
photos.guidelines.3: Original quality is preferred - don't worry about file size!
photos.guidelines.4: Please upload within a week or two while the memories are fresh!
photos.thanks.heading: Thank You for Sharing!
photos.thanks.body: We can't wait to relive all the special moments through your photos. Your memories will help make our wedding album complete!
login.heading: Welcome
login.subtitle: Please log in to continue
login.field.username.hint: From your invitation (e.g., John & Emma would be JoEm)
login.why.heading: Why do I need to log in?
login.why.body: Login credentials ensure that only invited guests can RSVP. Your username and PIN were included in your wedding invitation. This helps us track responses accurately and prevent spam RSVPs. With your login you'll also be able to add photos to the Google Drive and suggest songs through Spotify.
